outline.title: RemitFlow Resilience & Zero-Trust Architecture
outline.summary: Cover slide introducing the implementation of the attached requirements as adapted for RemitFlow’s regulated payments and compliance platform.

outline.title: Requirements Reframed for Payments
outline.summary: Translate insurance-oriented requirements into RemitFlow controls for payment mutations, ledger integrity, regulatory filing, tenant isolation, and agent operations.

outline.title: A Verified Principal Anchors Sensitive Paths
outline.summary: Show how Keycloak-backed trusted identity and PostgreSQL RLS replace caller-controlled identity assumptions across rate limiting, idempotency, and tenant controls.

outline.title: Financial Mutations Survive Cache Loss
outline.summary: Explain durable PostgreSQL idempotency reservations, leases, request hashes, and replay state that prevent duplicate financial execution after Redis or process failure.

outline.title: Regulatory Filing Becomes a Durable Workflow
outline.summary: Describe the tenant-scoped SAR and CTR queue with atomic claims, retry, dead-letter, administrative requeue, auditability, and Prometheus telemetry.

outline.title: Gateway and eBPF Layers Enforce Zero Trust
outline.summary: Show APISIX JWT and tenant-claim defenses together with Cilium workload policy, Hubble visibility, and staged strict enforcement.

outline.title: One Trace Connects Edge, Service, and Policy Evidence
outline.summary: Explain validated W3C trace context, Prometheus metrics, APISIX correlation, Cilium/Hubble flows, and actionable alerting.

outline.title: Recovery Is Immutable, Cross-Region, and Testable
outline.summary: Show immutable Object Lock backup, replication, checksum manifests, scheduled backup jobs, and explicitly isolated restore drills.

outline.title: Operations Maps Expose Approved Data Only
outline.summary: Present the tenant-scoped MapLibre administrator experience for agent, corridor, and approved fraud-response operations, with no customer telemetry or public tile fallback.

outline.title: Production Promotion Requires Evidence
outline.summary: Summarize passing build/type/test validation and the staging-only evidence gates required for regulated production promotion.
